note: Supplier listing plans. PLACEHOLDERS until GD7 §4 sets the listing fee L, the commission c and the founding terms N and M (guides/GD1 §4.2; every number: confirm at writing time). commission_bp is the default commission for a supplier on the plan, charged on a paid order's goods value excluding tax and delivery and deducted from the transfer; a supplier's own commission_bp overrides it. monthly_fee maps a currency to a monthly fee in minor units; null means no listing fee is invoiced.
